memory.source: pre-visual network displacement divided by dt, transported to endpoint camera axes using causal calibrated gyro rotation
memory.initialization: V10 compact weights; four new input columns zero; new input mean zero/std one

training_contract: Identical V10 target-frame plan, 2388 loss-bearing targets/epoch and 1520 steps per arm. Up to 19 preceding same-episode frames supply self-predicted history. BPTT through context; loss only at target. Never feed true velocity. Full original validation episodes select minimum normalized pose loss, including epoch zero. Compact fine-tuning is shared by both arms and differs from V10 original full-graph training.

evaluation.rule: No model changes after evaluating long flights. Freeze checkpoints and guards first; compare teacher, V10, no-history and feedback with balanced execution order, then repeat feedback for determinism. Selection requires gates on fresh confirmation set; report regressions and empty diagnostic bins.

scope: One fixed contrast. No GRU, fusion/rotation changes, new loss, inference depth, ground-truth predictor input, default replacement or server upload. Previous long set is regression evidence; fresh set is confirmation.
